steps.title: Prepare reaction mix
steps.instruction: Assemble the DENV‑2 prM/G multiplex TaqMan reaction using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088) following the kit’s recommended master‑mix composition and add the appropriate template RNA.

steps.title: Run qRT‑PCR cycling program
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the following conditions and run the assay:

substeps.instruction: Amplification: 40 cycles of 95 °C for 3 sec, then 60 °C for 30 sec with fluorescence acquisition at each cycle

steps.title: Interpret amplification results
steps.instruction: Examine the real‑time fluorescence curves; a satisfactory positive must display a sigmoidal shape with a clear log‑linear (LP) phase, a transition (TP) phase, and a plateau (PP) phase, fluorescence intensity above that of the positive control, and a threshold‑cycle (CT) value that crosses the predefined threshold early in the LP phase. Any sample that does not cross the threshold by 40 cycles is considered negative, and no‑template controls (NTCs) must show no amplification curve.
